paths.name: Full clear: red start → ends at blue buff

favors.reason: your laner on the blue-buff side has priority, so a gank there after the clear is likely to work

the enemy laner on the blue-buff side has little mobility to escape
a full clear is safe against a farming enemy jungler

avoid.reason: a full clear leaves your start buff side exposed to an early invader
your laner on the blue-buff side is likely to be pushed in
